json.reason: The respondent completed the survey in less than one third the median time (90 s vs 329 s) and answered 13 of 18 questions much faster than the rest, including several requiring thoughtful input. Three different rating grids were filled out with the same answer in every row, a classic indicator of careless responding. Both speed and pattern are independent and strong evidence.
